departments.kpi: Visual consistency, interaction responsiveness, and intuitive navigation

departments.name: Frontend Engineer AI
departments.mandate: Builds tactile, fluid Next.js/React components, command palette, and Web Audio synthesizers.

departments.name: Backend Engineer AI

departments.name: AI Engineer AI
departments.mandate: Develops Socratic cognitive scaffolding, misconception diagnosis, and dual-provider routing.
departments.kpi: Pedagogical fidelity, zero answer dumping, resilient fallback

departments.name: QA Engineer AI
departments.mandate: Maintains 275+ automated test suites, validates regression barriers, and simulates user journeys.
departments.kpi: 100% test pass rate, zero regression leaks to production

departments.name: Security Engineer AI
departments.mandate: Enforces token revocation, DPDP Act 2023 privacy standards, and prevents answer-key exposure.
departments.kpi: Zero secret leaks, zero client-authoritative privilege escalations

departments.name: Performance Engineer AI
departments.mandate: Optimizes bundle size, manages offline asset generation, and ensures instantaneous page loads.
departments.kpi: Initial JS load < 100kB, sub-second route transitions

departments.name: SEO Specialist AI
departments.mandate: Directs international structured data, anti-thin content gating, and dynamic indexing.
departments.kpi: 100% valid Schema.org graphs, indexation coverage across 15 countries

departments.name: Accessibility Specialist AI
departments.mandate: Guarantees WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, full keyboard navigability, and screen reader clarity.

departments.name: Data Analyst AI
departments.mandate: Analyzes retention decay curves, cognitive heatmaps, and learning drop-off points.

departments.name: Growth Strategist AI
departments.mandate: Drives sustainable international student adoption through transparent, ethical education.
departments.kpi: Organic referral quality, international student retention

roadmap.title: Global Command Palette (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K)
roadmap.userValue: Instant, effortless navigation across tools, curricula and quick actions.

roadmap.userValue: Tactile card hover lift, dynamic press feedback, and animated pulse badges.

roadmap.title: 5-Tier Socratic Cognitive Scaffolding in AI Tutor
roadmap.userValue: First principles derivation, misconception diagnosis, and Socratic hints without spoilers.

roadmap.title: AI CEO Autonomous Decision & Delegation Architecture
roadmap.userValue: Centralized intelligence coordinating 12 departments with audit logging and human approval.

roadmap.title: Interactive Concept Relationship Maps & Visual Lesson Explanations
roadmap.userValue: Visual formula calculators, prerequisite graph traversal, and step-by-step problem solver.

roadmap.title: Metacognitive Calibration & Ebbinghaus Decay Alerts
roadmap.userValue: Surfaces forgotten topics automatically before memory strength drops below 60%.

decisions.title: Adopt Web Audio API Synthesizer over External Audio Assets
decisions.rationale: External audio files cause unnecessary bandwidth drain and latency. Web Audio generates mathematically precise noise and binaural beats with 0 bytes network overhead.
decisions.impact: High performance, zero asset hosting cost, instant playback.

decisions.title: Global Command Palette Integration into Core Shell
decisions.rationale: Power students and international users require sub-second access to specific chapters and curricula without traversing multiple nested menus.
decisions.impact: Major UX leap, 100% keyboard accessible, eliminates navigation friction.

decisions.rationale: Eliminates bandwidth bottlenecks and provides zero-latency focus soundscapes
